How to Self-Host GitLab Without Starving It

GitLab bundles a lot of services into one app, which makes it genuinely RAM-hungry. Treat 4 GB as the floor for a small team and 8 GB as comfortable; its own docs recommend more as you grow. Self-host it when you want to own your source and CI or dodge per-seat pricing, size the server properly, and give CI runners their own room.
